chunks: As for his miracles, which prove his Imamate, they are more than can be counted. Among them:
ai.seo_question: What are the miracles of Imam Hasan al-Askari that prove his Imamate?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi highlights the innumerable miracles (mu'jizat) of Imam Hasan al-Askari (a.s.) as definitive proof of his divine appointment, emphasizing that their sheer volume transcends simple enumeration. This assertion underscores the Shia belief in the continuous manifestation of supernatural signs during the Minor and Major Gheebah, reinforcing the Imam's authority even in periods of political concealment.
